name: MACD No Sample
summary: This EA trades based on MACD indicator signals, entering positions when MACD crossover conditions are met. It uses a straightforward momentum-based approach without complex filtering or multi-indicator confirmation. The EA opens trades autonomously based on its own signal logic.
summary_zh: 该EA基于MACD指标信号进行交易，当MACD交叉条件满足时入场。采用直接的动量策略方法，没有复杂的过滤或多指标确认。EA根据自身信号逻辑自主开仓。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于MACD指标的经典动量交叉信号，当MACD主线与信号线发生交叉时产生交易信号。入场条件为MACD柱状图从负转正时做多，从正转负时做空，属于典型的动量追踪策略。出场条件依赖于反向交叉信号或固定的止损止盈设置，部分实现可能包含移动止损逻辑。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，未根据账户资金动态调整仓位大小。资金管理方面缺乏风险比例控制，没有根据波动率或账户余额计算最优仓位。整体策略逻辑简单直接，但在复杂市场环境下可能产生较多虚假信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the classic MACD momentum crossover signal, generating trade signals when the MACD main line crosses the signal line. Entry conditions trigger a buy when the MACD histogram turns from negative to positive, and a sell when it turns from positive to negative, representing a typical momentum-following approach. Exit conditions rely on reverse crossover signals or fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels, with some implementations potentially including trailing stop logic. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic adjustment based on account equity. Money management lacks proportional risk control, with no volatility-based or account-balance-based optimal position calculation. The overall strategy logic is straightforward but may generate numerous false signals in choppy or ranging market conditions.
pros: 策略逻辑简单明了，易于理解和调试
MACD是经过验证的经典动量指标，在趋势行情中表现良好
参数较少，减少了过拟合的风险
信号生成规则清晰，没有模糊的判断条件
pros_en: Strategy logic is simple and clear, easy to understand and debug
MACD is a proven classic momentum indicator that performs well in trending markets
Fewer parameters reduce the risk of overfitting
Clear signal generation rules with no ambiguous judgment conditions
cons: 仅依赖单一指标，在震荡行情中容易产生虚假信号导致频繁亏损
固定手数仓位管理无法适应不同账户规模和市场波动性
缺乏新K线检测机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
没有考虑点差和滑点影响，在短线交易中可能侵蚀利润
cons_en: Relies on a single indicator, prone to frequent false signals and losses in ranging markets
Fixed lot position sizing cannot adapt to different account sizes and market volatility
Lacks new bar detection mechanism, potentially opening duplicate positions on the same bar
Does not account for spread and slippage impact, which can erode profits in short-term trading
improvements: 增加多时间框架确认和额外指标过滤（如趋势线、ATR波动率过滤），减少虚假信号
实现动态仓位管理，根据账户余额百分比和ATR波动率自动计算最优手数
添加新K线检测机制，确保每根K线只交易一次，避免重复开仓
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe confirmation and additional indicator filtering (e.g., trend filter, ATR volatility filter) to reduce false signals
Implement dynamic position sizing that automatically calculates optimal lot size based on account equity percentage and ATR volatility
Add new bar detection mechanism to ensure only one trade per bar and prevent duplicate position openings

risk_points: 单一MACD指标在震荡市中频繁发出虚假信号，可能导致连续亏损
固定手数无法根据市场波动调整仓位，高波动时段风险暴露过大
缺少新K线检测可能导致同根K线上多次开仓增加风险敞口
risk_points_en: Single MACD indicator frequently generates false signals in ranging markets, potentially causing consecutive losses
Fixed lot sizing cannot adjust position based on market volatility, leading to excessive risk exposure during high volatility periods
Lack of new bar detection may cause multiple position openings on the same bar, increasing risk exposure

summary_en: This EA trades based on MACD indicator signals, entering positions when MACD crossover conditions are met. It uses a straightforward momentum-based approach without complex filtering or multi-indicator confirmation. The EA opens trades autonomously based on its own signal logic.
